description: Search the web and get a ranked list of results (title, url, snippet). Use it to find pages, then call read_url on the best results to read them as clean Markdown. Priced like one read (free daily calls, credits or x402).

format.description: markdown returns the content as Markdown only. json wraps the same Markdown with title, author, date, word count, links, tables and metadata (meta.warning flags results that may be incomplete); there is no separate plain-text copy. Default: markdown.

lang.description: Optional language code, e.g. en, nl

name: search
title: Web search
